mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_payroll ( payroll_code, company_code, user_id, payroll_period_code, payroll_period, payroll_type, bonus_method, bonus_rate, bonus_amount, payroll_name, payroll_start_date, payroll_end_date, payroll_date ) VALUES ( FN_MAKE_PAYROLL_CODE(), 'ROOT', #{userId}, #{payrollPeriodCode}, #{payrollPeriod}, 'j2', #{bonusMethod}, #{bonusRate}, #{bonusAmount}, #{payrollName}, #{payrollStartDate}, #{payrollEndDate}, #{payrollDate} )
mapper.select:
SELECT pr.payroll_period, cc.code_name AS payroll_type, pr.payroll_name, pr.payroll_date, pr.create_date, pr.payroll_period_code, COUNT(*) AS peopleNumber FROM tb_payroll pr JOIN tb_cm_code cc ON pr.payroll_type = cc.code WHERE 1=1
AND pr.payroll_type = #{payrollType}
AND pr.payroll_name like '%' || #{payrollName} || '%'
AND pr.payroll_date >= TO_DATE(#{paymentStartDate} , 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND pr.payroll_date <= TO_DATE(#{paymentEndDate} , 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY pr.payroll_period, cc.code_name, pr.payroll_name, pr.payroll_date, pr.create_date, pr.payroll_period_code

SELECT um.user_id, um.user_name, dm.dept_name AS dept
FROM tb_user_master um JOIN tb_dept_master dm ON um.dept = dm.dept_code WHERE 1=1 AND um.leave_date IS NULL
AND um.user_name like '%' || #{userName} || '%'
AND um.dept like '%' || #{dept} || '%'
